# Export-ZbxConfiguration

## SYNOPSIS

Exports hosts, templates and other objects as a configuration document.

## SYNTAX

### Pipeline (Default)

```
Export-ZbxConfiguration [-Format <ZabbixConfigurationFormat>] [-HostGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-TemplateGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]>] [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-Map <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMap>[]>] [-MediaType <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMediaType>[]>] [-Dashboard <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDashboard>[]>] [-ImageId <ulong[]>] [-GlobalRegexId <ulong[]>] [-BatchSize <int>] [-Unredacted] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Path

```
Export-ZbxConfiguration [-Format <ZabbixConfigurationFormat>] [-HostGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-TemplateGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]>] [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-Map <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMap>[]>] [-MediaType <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMediaType>[]>] [-Dashboard <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDashboard>[]>] [-ImageId <ulong[]>] [-GlobalRegexId <ulong[]>] [-BatchSize <int>] -Path <string> [-NoClobber] [-Unredacted] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### LiteralPath

```
Export-ZbxConfiguration [-Format <ZabbixConfigurationFormat>] [-HostGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-TemplateGroup <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]>] [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-Map <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMap>[]>] [-MediaType <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMediaType>[]>] [-Dashboard <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDashboard>[]>] [-ImageId <ulong[]>] [-GlobalRegexId <ulong[]>] [-BatchSize <int>] -LiteralPath <string> [-NoClobber] [-Unredacted] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

Name what to export with -HostGroup, -TemplateGroup, -HostReference, -Template, -Map, -MediaType, -Dashboard, -ImageId and -GlobalRegexId. A host group exports with the hosts in it, and a template group with the templates in it, so a group export can be imported as it stands. Hosts and templates are exported -BatchSize at a time (a single large export exhausts the frontend's PHP memory limit) and the answers merge into one document, written to the pipeline as text, or to -Path (replacing the file unless -NoClobber; -WhatIf previews the write), in the format the file's extension names unless -Format names it. Plaintext media-type/IPMI/OAuth secrets in the export are redacted by default, with a warning; pass -Unredacted to keep them, or answer yes to the confirmation prompt in a host that can show one.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Export a template as YAML

```powershell
Export-ZbxConfiguration -Template 'Web App' -Format Yaml
```

-Template takes template names, ids or objects; the document is written to the pipeline as one string (configuration.export). -Format is json by default, or xml/yaml.

### Example 2: Export the hosts of a group to a file

```powershell
$path = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) 'linux-servers.json'
Export-ZbxConfiguration -Host (Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers') -Path $path
(Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).zabbix_export.hosts | Select-Object host, @{ n = 'items'; e = { ($_.items | Measure-Object).Count } }
Remove-Item $path
```

-HostReference (alias -Host) takes host names, ids or objects, so the hosts Get-ZbxHost finds can be passed straight in (-HostGroup exports the group objects themselves, not their hosts). -Path writes the document to a file, in the format its extension names (.json, .xml, .yaml or .yml) unless -Format says so; a -Format the extension contradicts is refused.

### Example 3: Export the hosts a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Web servers' | Export-ZbxConfiguration -Format Xml |
    ForEach-Object { ([xml]$_).zabbix_export.hosts.host.host }
```

Piped hosts bind -HostReference; the whole selection becomes one document.

### Example 4: Export a media type, secrets redacted

```powershell
(Export-ZbxConfiguration -MediaType 'Email' -Format Yaml) -split '\r?\n' | Select-String -Pattern '^\s+(- )?(name|type|smtp_\w+):'
```

Plaintext media type, IPMI and OAuth secrets are redacted by default; -Unredacted keeps them (and asks first in an interactive session). Built-in objects such as the 'Email' media type may be exported like any other.
